description: Reads the rows in a track's sheet, newest last, to answer the person's questions about them ("what did I spend on dining this month?") or to check that a hack wrote what it should. Each row has its number and its values by column name. Filter with where (each column name to text the value must contain). Up to 200 rows a call; pass olderBefore as before for the page above. These are the person's own rows: use them only to help them, and do the totals yourself or with set_glance, not by copying rows elsewhere.

before.description: olderBefore from the previous call, to read older rows.

limit.description: How many of the newest rows to read. 50 if left out.

where.description: Column name to text its value must contain (any case), like {"Category": "Dining"}.

name: read_rows
title: Read a track's rows
